name: Hollow Vale painted forests and structures
status: review in Sprite Forge (projects/hollow-vale/sprites): only apply once every doc below is approved
scale: cell width = 224 px (same as the tiles); every frame is given as a box in cell units, its bottom edge is the base line
sideColour: files with a _m mask: the game multiplies the side colour (var(--p/e/g/k), owner colour for mines) into the neutral cloth through the mask

env/grove_N_b.webp.use: forest hex back layer, behind every figure

env/grove_N_f.webp.use: forest hex front layer over the unit (woods cover); anchored to the unit's feet: 3.17em x 1.606em at 34px, bottom 1.465em below the cell centre

tiles/forestfloor_N.webp.use: base tile for forest hexes (replaces forest_N.webp, which stays as fallback)

env/tower_N.webp + tower_N_m.webp.use: side towers: N=0 intact, 1 under 60% HP, 2 under 35% HP

env/farm|watchtower|barracks|well|cottag.use: BLD buildings and the Open Grave

env/cage_b.webp, cage_f.webp.use: Iron Cage: back behind the unit, front over it; anchored to the unit (2.3em x 3.63em)

env/mine.webp + mine_m.webp.use: gold mine at the back of the hex, owner flag

env/shrine.webp.use: standing rune stone at the back of shrine hexes
